SELECT
	BENEFICIARY
	,REMITTER
	,BENE_TIN
	,REMITTER_TIN
	,COUNTRY
	,TRAN_CODE
	,CHRG_COLL_FLG
	,CHRG_TRAN_ID
	,MODE_OF_PAY
	,REPRESENTATIVE_NAME
	,TRAN_ID
	,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(TRAN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,TD_REF_NO
	,TD_WITHDRWL_TYPE
	,PCC_CODE
	,MRT_NAME
	,FREE_TEXT
	,MOP_ID
	,PCC_CODE_DR
	,PCC_CODE_CR
	,OAP_REF_NUM_DR
	,OAP_REF_NUM_CR
	,ACCTS_OFFICER_CODE
	,CIF_ID
	,REMARKS3
	,CHQ_NO_CR
	,CHQ_NO_DR
	,PN_REF_NUM
	,REF_EBP_NUM
	,ORIG_TRAN_ID
	,BANK_ID
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,OTHER_BANK_ID
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM D360.STG_DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL
